optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Financial Crime Data Analyst, Transaction Screening
professionalSummary: Three years of experience as a Financial Crime Data Analyst in a bank’s transaction screening team, responsible for analysing screening alert outcomes, proposing rule and list changes with expected alert volumes, and coordinating approvals with the screening governance forum.
experienceHighlights: Analyzed weekly screening alert outcomes and proposed rule and list changes with quantified alert volume estimates.
Prepared monthly screening effectiveness packs in accordance with the bank’s pack standard and filed them in the governance repository.
Presented 27 proposals to the screening governance forum, successfully defending them against compliance challenges and securing approvals for 22 proposals.
Coordinated approved rule changes with the screening operations team, documenting responsibilities and hand‑over conditions.
Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each change note.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Two proposal documents with forum minutes and decisions; one monthly screening effectiveness pack; one change note with limitation section, all stored in the governance repository.
skills: Documentation of limitations and hand‑over conditions
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s direct experience and responsibilities in transaction screening, while the interview notes confirm the candidate’s ability to defend proposals and the reference call verifies employment dates. No evidence is provided regarding the candidate’s broader analytical skills or experience with other financial crime domains.

decisionBoundary.statement: The evidence supports the candidate’s qualifications for the role, but a human review is recommended to verify work sample authenticity and assess interview signals.

role.roleTitle: Financial Crime Data Analyst, Transaction Screening

evidence.text: Financial crime data analyst in a bank's transaction screening team for three years, analysing the screening alert outcomes each week and proposing rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes.

Work sample: two proposals with their forum minutes and decisions, one monthly screening effectiveness pack and one change note with its limitation section, with the governance repository references as a verification trail.
evidence.notes: Provides tangible evidence of proposals and volume estimates

evidence.text: Prepared the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard, with the packs filed in the screening governance repository.
Work sample: one monthly screening effectiveness pack

Presented twenty-seven proposals to the screening governance forum; the forum minutes record the compliance members' challenges on each and the forum's decision, with twenty-two proposals approved as presented and five amended.

Interviewer 2 note: when the panel's compliance member challenged the sample proposal's false-positive estimate, the candidate named the two months the estimate came from, gave the alert counts for each, stated which count she would use if the forum preferred the conservative one, and left the estimate range on the slide rather than changing the number.
Coordinated the approved rule changes with the screening operations team through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which were operations'; the approvals were the forum's.

Reference call with the former head of screening analytics: confirmed the candidate presented the proposals to the forum in the period, that approvals stayed with the forum, and confirmed the employment dates.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each change note.
Work sample: one change note with its limitation section

supportedClaims.witness: Financial crime data analyst in a bank's transaction screening team for three years, analysing the screening alert outcomes each week and proposing rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes.

supportedClaims.witness: Coordinated the approved rule changes with the screening operations team through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which were operations'; the approvals were the forum's.

supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each change note.
